title: LOL PlayLab Grand Opening
address: 50 Innovator Ave, Whitchurch-Stouffville, ON, MT, L4A 0Y2
summary: Join the fun at LOL PlayLab’s grand opening – Stouffville’s coolest spot for play, learning, and laughs!
description: Join the fun at LOL PlayLab’s grand opening – Stouffville’s coolest spot for play, learning, and laughs! LOL PlayLab Grand Opening Join us on December 20th as we officially open the doors to LOL PlayLab, a magical space where play, imagination, and learning come together. Bring your family for a full day of surprise activities , hands-on fun, special guests, and exclusive Grand Opening perks. This is a ONE-DAY celebration you won’t want to miss! Each Ticket is for One Adult+ One Kid 🌟 Special Guests, Characters & RoboBooth Fun! 🎭 Character Appearances: We’re excited to welcome Blippi and other beloved children’s characters for meet-and-greet moments throughout the day! Kids can dance, take photos, and interact with their favourite friends during surprise character pop-ins. 🤖 RoboBooth Interactive Photo Experience: Capture the magic of your visit with our RoboBooth , an interactive photo booth that creates fun pictures, boomerangs, and kid-friendly GIFs. Perfect for families who want to take home a memory from our Grand Opening! 🎉 With characters visiting, the RoboBooth running, and activities happening all day, every moment at our Grand Opening will be filled with excitement, surprises, and laughter.
